services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Since opening in 2003, Long Island Skydiving Center has proven to be the number one Brooklyn skydiving destination. Located 60 miles east of New York City, Long Island Skydiving Center is the top choice for skydiving near Brooklyn, NY by locals and tourists alike. Long Island Skydiving Center is conveniently located at the Brookhaven-Calabro Airport in Shirley, NY, and is the only Brooklyn skydiving center easily accessible by public transportation. You can reach us by the Long Island Rail Road, by subway, or by car - find directions to us here.
